title: NC-PLUS-SG-7: Repo snapshot probe: version every running system state in D1, verifiable without git
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-SG-7 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** Every running system has an immutable, timestamped snapshot of its config+code hash stored in D1, and the probe restores a prior snapshot and redeploys it successfully without touching git.
**Status:** open

Repo snapshot probe: version every running system state in D1, verifiable without git

Triage: Deploy/redeploy of a Worker and config hashing cannot be done by a doer limited to D1 reads/writes; it needs code-level API/wrangler capability. | first step: Add a probe module that snapshots config+hash rows into D1 and calls the deploy API (via Workers API/GitHub action) to restore a chosen snapshot.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
